Professor Deborah Blumenthal is recognised as one of Israel's leading specialists in the diagnosis and treatment of brain tumours. With more than 17 years of experience in medicine, she serves the health of many patients, consulting at top medical institutions in Israel and worldwide.

Her professional interests cover the diagnosis and treatment of various brain tumours, such as gliomas, meningiomas, astrocytomas and others. In her practice Professor Blumenthal applies modern approaches to chemotherapy and advanced methods of radiation therapy, including the RapidArc system.

Her career began in the United States, where she established herself as an outstanding figure in neuro-oncology, working at the country's major teaching and medical institutions.

Professor Blumenthal has more than 80 research papers to her name, along with the creation of innovative techniques in neuro-oncology.

EDUCATION

  • Graduated from a medical college in Georgia, USA
  • West Virginia University, USA — residency in neurology
  • Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, USA — specialisation in neuro-oncology
  • Hospital for cancer and allied diseases, New York, USA — specialisation in neuro-oncology
  • Huntsman Cancer Institute at the University of Utah, USA — specialisation in neuro-oncology; worked as a senior physician and then as head of the neuro-oncology department

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Member of the Society for Neuro-Oncology
  • Member of the American Academy of Neurology
  • Member of the Israel Association of Neuro-Oncology
  • Member of the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology

Dr Eli Tavdi has earned his reputation as a leading urologist on the international stage, specialising in the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the prostate and bladder. With more than 20 years of experience in urology, his qualifications and professionalism have become a gold standard in this field of medicine.

Dr Tavdi's career is rich in research and practical work at leading medical institutions around the world. He has diagnosed and treated complex and rare conditions, which has allowed him to build up invaluable experience and deep knowledge.

In his practice Dr Tavdi places particular importance on the use of advanced technologies. His mastery of endoscopic urological surgery deserves special mention. These minimally invasive methods allow him to operate with the greatest precision and safety for the patient, while ensuring the shortest possible recovery.

Dr Eli Tavdi also gives particular attention to continuous learning and self-education. He takes part regularly in international conferences and symposia, where he exchanges experience with other outstanding specialists. As a result, his treatment methods always meet the latest international standards.

The main emphasis of Dr Tavdi's work is an individual approach to every patient. He aims to ensure that each patient receives not only high-quality treatment but also attentive and considerate care. Many patients say that it is precisely this approach, together with Dr Tavdi's professionalism, that has allowed them to return to a full life after serious urological illness.

EDUCATION

  • Tbilisi University — graduated from the faculty of medicine
  • Sheba hospital, Israel — fellowship in general surgery
  • Wolfson hospital, Israel — fellowship in urological surgery

Membership of international organisations

  • Israel Urological Association
  • Israel society for the treatment of sexual disorders
  • Endourological Society
  • Society of Ambulatory Urology

Specialisation: oncology

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Ella Tepper is a leading Israeli oncologist with extensive experience in treating a wide range of cancers. She is a recognised specialist in radiological, biological and chemotherapeutic treatment, applying the newest and most effective medical technologies in cancer care.

  • Tumours of the digestive tract
  • Tumours of the colon and rectum
  • Tumours of the urinary and reproductive systems
  • Tumours of the breast
  • Tumours of the musculoskeletal system
  • Tumours of the brain
  • Tumours of the skin and subcutaneous tissue
  • Biological cancer treatment
  • Hormonal cancer treatment
  • Slowing the growth of cancer cells

Summary:

Dr Ella Tepper is a leading oncologist in Israel with more than 30 years of experience. She is known for the strong results she achieves in cancer treatment through the use of the newest protocols in radiotherapy and in biological and chemical therapy. Dr Tepper has made considerable progress in minimising the side effects of cancer treatment and gives particular attention to preventing recurrence. She has saved the lives and restored the health of thousands of patients from around the world.

Dr Tepper is also actively engaged in research, taking part in international projects to develop new cancer treatments. She presents regularly at the annual meetings of the Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy and lectures on oncology.

Education and clinical experience:

  • Doctor of Medicine: Kaunas Medical Academy, Lithuania
  • Doctor of Medical Sciences: Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in oncology: Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Fellowship: oncology department, Kaplan Medical Centre, Rehovot, Israel
  • Advanced training: modern protocols for treating cancer patients with radiotherapy at the European School of Oncology in Cyprus and Italy

Academic and research work:

Dr Tepper takes an active part in international research projects and presents regularly at conferences and seminars. She also lectures in the oncology department, sharing her experience and knowledge with colleagues and students.

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Cancer Association (ICA)
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Dr Ella Tepper is known for her advanced treatment methods and her individual approach to every patient, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Dr Evgeny Moshkovich is an outstanding Israeli endocrinologist with a rich twenty years of experience. His expertise covers both adult and paediatric endocrinology. Evgeny is a proponent of a multidisciplinary approach to treatment, working closely with other specialists to develop personalised treatment plans.

Among his key specialisations are diabetes, disorders of the thyroid and parathyroid glands, the adrenal glands and the pituitary, and of the hypothalamic-pituitary system.

Dr Moshkovich currently heads the Institute of Endocrinology, Diabetology and Metabolic Disorders and is chief endocrinologist at the Assuta clinic. Holding a doctoral degree in medicine, he has contributed to the field by writing more than 20 research papers.

He attends international symposia and congresses on endocrinology regularly and takes an active part in discussions and seminars on diabetes at international level. His expert opinion and deep knowledge make him an authority in his field.

Dr Moshkovich is also known for his media work: he appears frequently on radio and television, discussing health matters and sharing the latest developments in endocrinology. He is also the author of several important books in this field.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of medicine, medical university in Kursk, Russia
  • Residency at the Meir hospital, Kfar Saba, Israel
  • Residency and post of chief physician at the Institute of Endocrinology, Meir clinic, Israel

LANGUAGES

  • Russian
  • English
  • Hebrew

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Diabetes Association

Professor Eyal Winkler is a leading Israeli plastic surgeon specialising in burns medicine and in restorative and reconstructive microsurgery.

Specialisation:

  • Burns medicine
  • Restorative medicine after surgery
  • Reconstructive microsurgery
  • Facelift
  • Eyelid correction
  • Rhinoplasty
  • Liposuction
  • Maxillofacial surgery
  • Melanoma
  • Breast asymmetry

Education and clinical experience:

  • 1979-1986: Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba, Israel
  • 1989: Specialisation in plastic surgery, Sheba medical centre
  • 1992-1998: Advanced training in plastic and reconstructive microsurgery
  • 1994: Residency in reconstructive microsurgery, NYU hospital, New York, USA
  • Fellowship in aesthetic surgery, medical centres in the USA and Canada
  • 2000-2003: Senior physician, plastic surgery department
  • 2002-2005: Head of the burns surgery department, Chaim Sheba Medical Centre
  • From 2011: Head of the plastic surgery department, Chaim Sheba Medical Centre.

Academic experience:

  • 1996-2001: Teacher in the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Association of Plastic Surgeons (chairman, 2005-2009)
  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Microsurgery
  • American Society for Aesthetic Plastic Surgery

Dr Felix Bokstein is recognised as one of Israel's most authoritative specialists in neuro-oncology, with more than 30 years of continuous experience. Over those years he has supported and helped thousands of patients. He currently heads one of the largest neuro-oncology centres in Israel and makes active use of the newest treatment methods, including targeted therapy.

His professional focus covers the treatment and diagnosis of tumours of the brain and spinal cord, such as gliomas, ganglioblastomas and astrocytomas. Alongside his practice, Dr Bokstein makes a valuable contribution to the scientific community in Israel: he takes part regularly in symposia, writes research papers and mentors students in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

On the doctor's education: in 1980 Felix Bokstein completed his studies in the medical faculty of the First Moscow State Medical University. After finishing a residency in neurology in 1983 he continued to practise in his home country. After emigrating to Israel he had his qualifications recognised and began specialist training in neurology at the Ichilov clinic. His path then led to Hadassah Ein Kerem in Jerusalem, where he developed his skills in neuro-oncology.

EDUCATION

  • First Moscow State Medical University, Russia.
  • Ichilov public clinic (residency, Israel).
  • Hadassah Ein Kerem (specialisation in neuro-oncology, Jerusalem, Israel).

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Association of Neuro-Oncology
  • Israel Neurological Association
  • Israel Association of Clinical Medicine
